summary: Midday throughput lull in dedicated pool during short-stream bursts causing autoscaler lag and per-tenant GPU scarcity
description:
Issue summary:
Customer NovusChat reports repeated mid-day throughput lulls in their Dedicated pool (prod-us-west) that coincide with a high volume of short-lived streaming requests. The symptom is a sudden P99 and P95 throughput drop for routes pinned to dedicated capacity, lasting 3–8 minutes before partial recovery.

Impact:
- Intermittent user-facing latency increases for NovusChat users (p99 latency up 4x).
- Background request queueing observed; some requests hit client-side timeouts.
- Business impact: degraded chat responsiveness during peak local hours.

Environment:
- Dedicated cluster: prod-us-west (reserved capacity for NovusChat).
- Customer tier: Dedicated/enterprise.
- Models: redwood/open-compat-13b and openlm/turbo-8k.
- Autoscaler config: min_replicas=4, max_replicas=24, scale_window=120s, short_stream_heuristic_enabled=true.

Steps to reproduce (customer-provided):
1) Send 300-600 concurrent short streaming sessions (1–3s per stream, frequent restarts) distributed across 20 tenants on the same dedicated pool.
2) Observe scheduler allocations and autoscaler decisions via the Console.
3) See throughput collapse on pinned routes and elevated request queueing.

Observed metrics & artifacts:
- GPU allocation saturation spikes on a subset of hosts (nvlink contention + high PCIe IO).
- Autoscaler shows delayed pod spin-up: mean time-to-ready increased from 35s -> 90s during events.
- KV cache eviction rate increases sharply; cache miss ratio climbs from 2% -> 18% within event window.
- Per-tenant slot utilization shows uneven hot-spotting: a small number of tenants consume many small slots, causing slot fragmentation.
- Monitoring screenshots and Prometheus query outputs attached in PR above.

Logs (selected):
- scheduler: "failed to place due to slot_fragmentation threshold exceeded"
- autoscaler: "scale_up blocked by placement_safety_check until rebalancer finishes"
investigation_notes: 2026-03-13 10:22 UTC - First customer alert. NovusChat support says issues start around 09:30 local (us-west).
2026-03-13 10:40 UTC - SRE reproduced with synthetic short-stream load in staging; observed identical pattern (rapid small streams + KV cache churn).
2026-03-13 11:05 UTC - Hypothesis A: slot fragmentation from many small streaming sessions causes inefficient GPU packing, increasing per-request overhead and triggering autoscaler oscillation.
2026-03-13 11:30 UTC - Hypothesis B: KV cache eviction storms due to simultaneous cold starts reduce effective throughput and increase compute pressure per token.
2026-03-13 12:10 UTC - Collected pprof traces of serving runtime during an event: there is increased kernel scheduling latency and higher PCIe stalls on affected hosts.
2026-03-13 12:45 UTC - Rebalancer job ran and temporarily restored throughput; however, hotspot returns if short-stream pattern persists.
2026-03-13 13:12 UTC - Correlation found with tenant partitioning: several noisy tenants in same placement group coincided with drop windows.
2026-03-13 14:00 UTC - Eng scheduled a canary change to reduce short_stream_heuristic aggressiveness in staging for validation.
comments: Maya Chen (Support) 2026-03-13 10:30: Customer reports p99 jump to ~7s for chat routes; they attached Console graphs. Asked SRE for priority triage.
Liam O'Connor (SRE) 2026-03-13 10:40: Reproduced in staging. Assigning to autoscaler and serving-runtime owners. Investigating slot packing and KV eviction signals.
Priya Rao (Platform Eng) 2026-03-13 11:20: Noted that the rebalancer throttles in the presence of many small streams due to lock contention. Will add instrumentation to quantify lock hold times.
NovusChat CSM (Alina Park) 2026-03-13 11:55: Customer accepts temporary mitigation if it avoids user-visible timeouts; asked for ETA on fix and whether they should reroute traffic.
Liam O'Connor (SRE) 2026-03-13 12:30: Deployed mitigation in prod-us-west: increased autoscaler min_replicas from 4->6 and enabled a transient slot-smoothing policy. Monitoring impact now.
Maya Chen (Support) 2026-03-13 13:00: Customer confirmed initial improvement: p95 improved but p99 still elevated during sustained bursts.
resolution: Mitigation applied: autoscaler min_replicas increased to 6 for NovusChat's pool and a slot-smoothing policy was enabled to prefer larger batch packing for short streams. Temporarily pinned noisy tenant subset to separate placement group to reduce fragmentation. Follow-ups: (1) Engineering to instrument lock contention in rebalancer and shipping a rebalancer efficiency patch (PR linked). (2) Autoscaler change to introduce fast-path for short-stream bursts (design doc linked). (3) Postmortem to recommend customer-side best practices for short-stream client batching. Customer will be updated with timeline.
